about: Pattern list of redact-scan.js (plan section 4, Redaction). This file is the scanner's only allowlisted path. Patterns are generic shapes; nothing here names a real person. JavaScript regular expressions, applied per line with the given flags.

patterns.what: any user@host address (the empty <> never matches)
absolute path under the root user's home
absolute path under a named home directory
a claude.ai session or chat link

allow_notes.a@b.c: synthetic identity of the codex-review offline suite's scratch repos
allow_notes.git@github.com: the generic SSH user of a GitHub remote URL, not a person

bundle_authors_note: Author and committer names a toy repo bundle may carry (synthetic only); any other name in a bundle's log is reported.
